description: This file contains a Composable function 'HiddenAppsScreen' which constructs a UI screen displaying a list of hidden apps using Jetpack Compose. It references a ViewModel 'HiddenAppsViewModel' to get data and uses Material3 components for layout and styling.

classes.name: HiddenAppsViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel providing the list of hidden apps, exposing a Flow or StateFlow named 'hidden' which is collected as state in the UI.

methods.name: HiddenAppsScreen
methods.description: Composable function to display a screen with a top app bar titled 'Hidden Apps' and a list of app names marked as hidden.
